[[File:Warped tortoise icon.png|left]]
'''Warped tortoises''' are [[Slayer monsters]] which require level 56 [[Slayer]] to damage. They can be found in the [[Poison Waste Slayer Dungeon]] during the quest [[The Path of Glouphrie]] and can be fought there during and after the quest. Players must have the [[crystal chime]] in their backpack to fight them.

The dungeon may be reached by using [[spirit tree]]s. Using [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|BKP}} or by walking from [[Castle Wars]] will take players to an area with a grapple crossing requiring any [[Crossbows|crossbow]] and a [[mithril grapple]] to cross the river to the dungeon. Additionally, players who have completed the [[medium Tirannwn achievements]] can use the [[Tirannwn quiver 2]] teleport to the [[Poison Waste Slayer Dungeon]] to arrive within the first room of the dungeon.

Players cannot receive the [[Warped tortoises (Slayer assignment)|Slayer assignment for warped tortoises]] unless they have completed the quest.

The tortoises are known for their higher drop rate of [[tortoise shell|normal]] and [[perfect shell]]s over their uncorrupted counterparts, the former used for [[war tortoise pouch]]es and the latter to given to [[Barlak]] for coins and small [[Crafting]] experience.

==Strategy==
{{cquote2|The last Warped tortoise I killed I found a crossbow with bolts took them down effectively.

Warped tortoises are creatures tainted by magical waste. They are vulnerable to an elven chime.|[[Chaeldar]]}}

Warped tortoises are completely immune to any attack, unless players have a [[crystal chime]] in their inventory or on their [[tool belt]]. They mainly attack with [[magic]], which can deal moderate damage. They are weak against [[ranged]], particularly crossbows. A [[dragon crossbow]] or better is sufficient.

There are relatively few areas where these foes may be killed without any interference from nearby level 82 [[warped terrorbird]]s, which are aggressive and attack with ranged and melee. One is at the entrance, where there are two quick tortoise spawns. A second is at the end of dungeon where there is a room with two warped tortoises alone. This could prove useful for those on a [[Slayer]] task, particularly if players have 96 [[Summoning]] for a [[Pack yak]].

Warped tortoises are unaffected by [[aggression potion]]s and must be clicked to cleanse and attack.

==Trivia==
* At one time it was possible to heal using [[Guthan's set]] even when the tortoises were not made vulnerable by the crystal chimes. This was because at one point Guthan's set counted potential damage inflicted on foes even when actual damage was not possible due to prayer or other invulnerability. An update on [[9 June]] [[2009]] fixed this bug.
* Warped tortoises were originally the highest leveled monsters to drop [[cabbage]]s, with the record being broken with the release of the [[cabbagemancer]] on [[26 February]] [[2018]].
* There seems to be a glitch where warped tortoises are immune to stuns; if stunned with [[Impact]] they will be unaffected, while if [[Asphyxiate]] is used the first hit will not stun while the remaining hits will.
* As of [[1 February]] [[2018]], the highest kill count for these monsters was 60,811 kills.{{CiteReddit|author=Mod Shauny|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/runescape/comments/7uqsoh/top_10_killers_per_slayer_creature/|title=Top 10 killers per Slayer Creature|quote=Here are the top 10 kills for each Slayer creature in RuneScape, be aware that we've not listed display names for privacy purposes however if you wish to brag about one number being yours then we won't stop you!|date=2 February 2018|archiveurl=http://archive.is/Qgydj|archivedate=28 February 2020|notes=|name=}}
** This had not increased by [[6 May]] 2018.{{CiteReddit|author=Mod Shauny|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/runescape/comments/8hjcvq/top_slayer_killers_6th_may_2018/|title=Top Slayer Killers - 6th May 2018|quote=Here are the top 10 kills for each Slayer creature in RuneScape, be aware that we've not listed display names for privacy purposes however if you wish to brag about one number being yours then we won't stop you!|date=6 May 2018|archiveurl=http://archive.is/Fxc11|archivedate=28 February 2020|notes=|name=}}
